goal: Replace community-template enhancement import v1's observed-value-derived socket capacity and inherited read-only fallback with a versioned static socket authority, then import gems, enchants and embellishments as ordinary editable canonical selections without weakening backend legality or release gates.
userValue: After importing a community gear template, players immediately see the template's gems, enchants and embellishments and can replace them normally; the Frost Mage reference template shows 8/8 gems, 6/8 enchants and 2/2 embellishments instead of hidden or locked inherited facts.
nonGoals: No client trust for raw gem_id, enchant_id, embellishment or forged option identities
No runtime Battle.net, Raider.IO, SimC or Wowhead request when a player changes gear or opens the enhancement sheet
No slot-wide inference that every ring or neck has the highest socket count observed on one exact item variant
No expansion of the public template policy beyond active real-player observed profiles
No PostgreSQL schema migration or replacement of the Active Gear and Community Release model
No Catalyst, stat-weight, talent, set-bonus, proc or broad gear-catalog redesign
No merge before exact-candidate API, 40-spec shadow and real WeChat verification

decisionLog.decision: The user approved option B: replace v1 inherited/read-only enhancement semantics with direct editable canonical selections backed by a new static release authority.
Runtime gear changes consume immutable Active Gear Release facts; external evidence is refreshed only by candidate-time periodic or differential maintenance.
The Frost Mage acceptance reference is gems 8/8, enchants 6/8 and embellishments 2/2, all editable and without inherited/read-only user copy.
Socket evidence is typed as a proven minimum total capacity and combined by max. An exact two-socket jewelry item does not make every item in that slot two-socket.
Unknown enhancement values never become raw Intent. The gear may import with an empty normal editor slot and a plain data-coverage warning; capacity contradictions block the candidate release.
Rollout first deploys the exact Task 3 compatibility-reader commit and proves active v1 API parity, then deploys the final candidate and repeats v1 smoke before any v2 release cutover.

Fixed 8/8, 6/8 and 2/2 live acceptance applies only to candidate-frozen observed_profile_mage_frost with source and release identity; other Mage templates must import completely and remain editable but may have different counts.
